purpose: Calibrate one fixed cheap_L4 evaluator and decide whether a held-out Stage B mechanism screen is ready.
claim_boundary: Stage A is calibration/readiness evidence only. It does not authorize a decision-equivalence claim, a latency claim, native system timing, or closed-loop evaluation.

scope.independence_unit: one independent Wall observation with one complete chained CEM planner call

fixed_settings.objective: Existing DINO-WM Wall planner objective without modification; lower is better.
fixed_settings.tie_break: Stable ascending candidate-index tie-break after objective value.
fixed_settings.candidate_population_rule: cheap_L4 and full use the identical candidate population in every round.
fixed_settings.noise_rule: The chained CEM noise schedule is recorded per round and is shared by the paired cheap/full evaluations.
fixed_settings.checkpoint_and_preprocessing: Identical checkpoint, evaluation mode, preprocessing, action bounds, observation, goal, and candidate/action tensors for cheap_L4 and full.

cheap_evaluator.name: cheap_L4
cheap_evaluator.construction: The existing 6-layer ViT predictor's first four Transformer blocks plus the existing final LayerNorm.

calibration_record.record_unit: one observation containing all ten chained CEM rounds

array_rules.J_tilde: Exactly 300 finite numeric values from cheap_L4.
array_rules.J_full: Exactly 300 finite numeric values from the full six-layer predictor.
array_rules.abs_error: Exactly 300 finite values, recomputed as abs(J_tilde[i] - J_full[i]).
array_rules.cheap_top30: Stable top-30 indices from J_tilde, ordered by (value, candidate index).
array_rules.full_top30: Stable top-30 indices from J_full, ordered by (value, candidate index).
array_rules.A: Unique candidate indices in [0,299] recomputed from the frozen epsilon rule.
array_rules.full_cutoff: J_full at the 30th stable-ranked candidate; lower-objective minimization.

calibration_record.chain_rule: round 0 records the initial input_mu/input_sigma; for round r>0, input_mu and input_sigma equal the same observation's output_mu and output_sigma from round r-1. No reset to a shared state is allowed.
calibration_record.epsilon_rule: For each round r, epsilon_round is the maximum abs_error over all six calibration observations at that same round. It must be generated only from calibration.jsonl; no validation-derived or hand-edited epsilon is accepted.
calibration_record.interval_rule: For each candidate i, L_i=J_tilde[i]-epsilon_round and U_i=J_tilde[i]+epsilon_round. Let tau be the 30th stable-ranked U value. A={i | L_i <= tau}.
calibration_record.coverage_rule: full_top30_in_A is true exactly when every full_top30 index occurs in A. Stage A reports this calibration property but does not treat it as held-out decision evidence.

completeness_finite.rule: Exactly six unique required observations, each with exactly ten rounds indexed 0..9; all required arrays and scalars are present, finite, and shape-valid; chain continuity holds.
completeness_finite.failure_action: FAIL and do not authorize Stage B.

cheap_identity.rule: Every record identifies cheap_evaluator exactly as cheap_L4 with layer_count=4 and total_predictor_layers=6; implementation metadata must not claim another layer count.
cheap_identity.failure_action: FAIL and do not authorize Stage B.

epsilon_provenance.rule: Every round epsilon_round equals the verifier-recomputed calibration maximum for that round; epsilon_source must be calibration_max_abs_error if present and no record may provide an alternate epsilon.
epsilon_provenance.failure_action: FAIL and do not authorize Stage B.

ambiguity_gate.quantile_definition: Nearest-rank p90: sort 60 ratios and select 1-based rank ceil(0.90*60)=54; median is the mean of ranks 30 and 31.
ambiguity_gate.rule: PASS only when median ambiguity ratio <=0.25 and nearest-rank p90 <=0.40.
ambiguity_gate.adjustment_policy: Thresholds are frozen before seeing results. Any future adjustment requires a new freeze and must be justified by compute structure/break-even accounting, never by observed calibration outcomes.

authorization.stage_b_held_out_mechanism_screen: Authorized only after readiness_gate and ambiguity_gate both PASS; Stage B must use held-out observations and this frozen epsilon.

prohibited: Do not load a model or run inference inside the verifier.
Do not use hashes as a substitute for recorded values or comparisons.
Do not tune layer count, precision, interval threshold, or epsilon after observing calibration outcomes.
Do not reset mu or sigma between chained CEM rounds.
Do not infer held-out, decision, latency, or closed-loop evidence from Stage A.
